actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Financial Services.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an 18-member task force of experts and researchers supported by staff and federal detailees.
dimensions.evidence: The Task Force shall be composed of 18 members

dimensions.assessment: Conducts studies, holds hearings, gathers federal data, and issues a report with recommendations.
dimensions.evidence: evaluate and quantify the impact that a lack of affordable housing has on other areas of life and life outcomes

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of necessary sums for fiscal years 2027 through 2030, covering member expenses and staff.
dimensions.evidence: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out this Act for fiscal years 2027 through 2030.

dimensions.assessment: Creates a temporary advisory legislative branch task force without regulatory or executive enforcement powers.
dimensions.evidence: There is established a bipartisan task force to be known as the Task Force on the Impact of the Affordable Housing Crisis.

dimensions.assessment: Terminates no later than two years after all members are appointed, with funding authorized through fiscal year 2030.
dimensions.evidence: The Task Force shall terminate not later than 2 years after the date on which all members of the Task Force are appointed

missing_information: Exact dollar amount authorized to be appropriated for the task force
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes a temporary bipartisan task force to evaluate the impacts of the affordable housing crisis, quantify costs, and report recommendations to Congress.
